commit.message:
Rename mcp.json to .mcp.json so Claude Code loads the MCP server (#21)

The plugin's MCP server config is currently at
`plugins/circle/mcp.json`, but Claude Code only auto-loads plugin MCP
servers from `.mcp.json` (dotfile). As a result, when users install
`circle-skills` from the marketplace, the Circle MCP connector at
`https://api.circle.com/v1/codegen/mcp` is not registered and the
related skills can't talk to it.

Renaming to `.mcp.json` is a no-content change — the file's JSON is
already valid Claude Code plugin MCP config.

Verified locally:
- `claude plugin marketplace add circlefin/skills`
- `claude plugin install circle-skills`
- Without rename: `mcp.json` is treated as a regular file; no MCP server
is registered for the plugin.
- With rename: Claude Code picks up `.mcp.json` on install and the
`circle` MCP server appears alongside the skills.

Reference: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/plugins
